inspiration: Sky dome built from several layers: a canopy colour ramp from the zenith to the horizon that changes for dawn, day and dusk, two cloud decks projected onto a flat ceiling so they crowd toward the horizon, and a sun disc with a glow placed where the shadow direction says. Recreate with our own palette and cloud shapes. Reference: README.md lines 386-412.

Armour as tiers: each equipment slot has a ladder from light cloth to heavy plate, and the silhouette and the material texture are chosen as a pair, so a heavy tier can never look like cloth. Recreate with our own tier names and a fresh silhouette per tier. Reference: README.md lines 705-716 (character section).

Flame cards: crossed flat cards with a flame texture scrolling up over time, a soft additive halo, and a slow scale pulse where each copy starts at its own point in the cycle, so a row of braziers does not flicker in step. Recreate with an ember palette and a split-tongue silhouette. Reference: README.md lines 652-668 (glows and flame cards).

Smoke that is authored too faint to read: the file's own opacity curve is so low that a column of puffs vanishes, so the viewer boosts the opacity deliberately. Lesson to copy: author smoke alpha for the screen, not for the data. Reference: README.md lines 693-700 (particles section).

Biome-keyed scatter: a sprite table grouped by biome (meadow, scrub, reeds, rocks, ferns and so on), a density map that keeps plants off snow and steers them to shorelines, and cell-seeded generation so each cell's plants are the same every time. Recreate with our own plant families. Reference: README.md lines 414-456 and web/grass.js (line 451 quoted in the README).

Instanced slot particles: each emitter is a fixed set of slots reborn on a clock with a hash for position and direction, so the vertex shader places every particle from time and slot number with no simulation. Recreate with our own rebirth pattern. Reference: README.md lines 671-700 (particles section).

briefs.label: Layered-armour tier ladder
briefs.why: Each tier must read at 375 wide as a different silhouette, not only a different colour. One signature behaviour: a heavier tier visibly changes the outline, not only the shade.
briefs.keep: kept: a per-slot ladder of tiers where the tier sets the silhouette and the material sets the look, chosen together.
briefs.change: changed: our own tier names and materials, a different outline per tier (shoulder plates, skirt length, gauntlet shape), and our own species. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only: 'a heavy hide warrior in tiers'.

briefs.label: Brazier flame cards
briefs.why: A brazier that flickers out of step with its neighbours makes a camp feel alive from across a clearing. One signature effect: a flame that visibly moves on a clock, offset per copy.
briefs.keep: kept: crossed flat flame cards with a scrolling flame texture and an additive halo; each copy offset in the cycle.
briefs.change: changed: our own ember palette, a split-tongue flame silhouette, and a halo tinted to match our light colour. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only: 'a camp brazier'.

briefs.label: Canopy dome at dusk
briefs.why: A canopy that changes colour across the day and clouds that crowd the horizon give a readable sense of time at any screen width. One signature: clouds read as a flat deck pressed toward the horizon.
briefs.keep: kept: a ring-based canopy colour ramp and two cloud decks projected onto a flat ceiling; the sun placed from the shadow direction.
briefs.change: changed: our own palette and cloud shapes, the sun placed from our own light vector, and a dawn-to-dusk ramp of our own. Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only: 'a sky dome with cloud decks'.

briefs.label: Biome scatter sprites
briefs.why: Plants that thin out on snow and bunch on shorelines give a zone its ground character for almost no draw cost. One signature behaviour: a density map steers the scatter, so the same plant table reads differently in each zone.
briefs.keep: kept: a sprite table grouped by biome, a density map, cell-seeded generation.
briefs.change: changed: our own plant families and card shapes, and our own density rules (wet ground, not snow). Rule: recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy. Category-level only: 'low ground plants by biome'.
